records.description: Lalalala... you now know the cult's hymn sung in Liberty Bay by heart. Not that hard, considering that it mainly consists of two notes and repetitive lyrics.
records.name: Chorister

records.description: Who's the milkman? You are!
records.name: The Milkman

records.description: You've always been a rebel - admit it! Supplying prisoners, caring for outcasts, stealing from the rich and giving to the poor - no wait, that was another story.
records.name: Vive la Resistance

records.description: Simple hams and bread merely make you laugh. You're the master of the extra-ordinaire, melter of cheese, fryer of bat wings and shaker of shakes. Delicious!
records.name: Culinary Master

records.description: You follow the path of dreams and that of responsibility without self-centred power. Free from greed and selfishness, you help others without expecting a reward.
records.name: Nightmare Knight

records.description: You've joined the undead bone brothers - making death your enemy and your weapon as well. Devouring what's weak and leaving space for what's strong is your primary goal.
records.name: Bone Brother

records.description: You travelled the world for an almost meaningless prayer - but at least you don't have to do that again and can get a new blessed stake in the blink of an eye.
records.name: Blessed!

records.description: You're a talented merchant who's able to handle wares with care, finds good offers and digs up rares every now and then. Never late to complete an order, you're a reliable trader - at least in Rashid's eyes.
records.name: Recognised Trader

records.description: You travelled the surreal realm of the elemental spheres, summoned and slew the Lord of the Elements, all in order to retrieve neutral matter. And as brave as you were, you couldn't have done it without your team!
records.name: Lord of the Elements

records.description: You re-enacted the Taming of the Shrew on a beach setting and proved that you can handle capricious girls quite well. With or without fish tails.
records.name: Beach Tamer

records.description: When you do something, you do it right. You have an opinion and you stand by it - and no one will be able to convince you otherwise. On a sidenote, you're a bit on the brutal and war-oriented side, but that's not a bad thing, is it?
records.name: Follower of Azerus

records.description: You're a peacekeeper and listen to what the small people have to say. You've made up your mind and know who to help and for which reasons - and you do it consistently. Your war is fought with reason rather than weapons.
records.name: Follower of Palimuth

records.description: You jump at every opportunity for a hunting challenge that's offered to you and carry out those tasks with deadly precision. You're a hunter at heart and a valuable member of the Paw & Fur Society.
records.name: Elite Hunter

records.description: You're familiar with hunting tasks and have carried out quite a few already. A bright career as hunter for the Paw & Fur society lies ahead!
records.name: Huntsman

records.description: For you, a kiss is more than a simple touch of lips. You kiss maidens and deadbeats alike with unmatched affection and faced death and rebirth through the kiss of the banshee queen. Lucky are those who get to share such an intimate moment with you!
records.name: Passionate Kisser

records.description: You've proven yourself as a worthy member of the 'family' and successfully carried out numerous spy missions for your 'uncle' to support the Venorean traders and their goals.
records.name: Top AVIN Agent

records.description: Girl power! Whether you're female or not, you've proven absolute loyalty and the willingness to put your life at stake for the girls brigade of Carlin.
records.name: Top CGB Agent

records.description: Conspiracies and open secrets are your daily bread. You've shown loyalty to the Thaian crown through your courage when facing enemies and completing spy missions. You're an excellent field agent of the TBI.
records.name: Top TBI Agent

records.description: Pack your spy gear and get ready for some dangerous missions in service of a secret agency. You've shown you want to - but can you really do it? Time will tell.
records.name: Secret Agent

records.description: You're an aspiring mago-mechanic. Science and magic work well together in your eyes - and even though you probably delivered countless wrong charges while working for Telas, you might just have enough knowledge to build your own golem now.
records.name: Golem in the Gears

records.description: You know Banuta like the back of your hand and are good at destroying caskets and urns. The sight of giant footprints doesn't keep you from exploring unknown areas either.
records.name: Friend of the Apes

records.description: You've proven to be a valuable ally to the Marid, and earned Gabel's trust. As long as you stand with the Marid you are welcome to trade with Haroun and Nah'bob. Though the Djinn War has still not ended, the Marid can't fail with you on their side.
records.name: Marid Ally

records.description: Even though the Efreet welcomed you only reluctantly and viewed you as "only a human" for quite some time, you managed to impress Malor and gained his respect. As long as you stand with the Efreet, you are permitted to trade to with the green djinns.
records.name: Efreet Ally

records.description: Dreams - are your reality? Strange visions, ticking clocks, going to bed and waking up somewhere completely else - that was some trip, but you're almost sure you actually did enjoy it.
records.name: Lucid Dreamer

records.description: You've been to places most people don't even know the names of. Collecting botanic, zoologic and ectoplasmic samples is your daily business and you're always prepared to discover new horizons.
records.name: Explorer

records.description: Not even the hostile underwater environment stops you from doing your duty for the Explorer Society. Scouting the Quara realm is a piece of cake for you.
records.name: Sea Scout

records.description: Warm, furry and cuddly - though that same bear you just hugged would probably rip you into pieces if he had been conscious, he reminded you of that old teddy bear which always slept in your bed when you were still small.
records.name: Bearhugger

records.description: You don't hunt them, you talk to them. You know that ghosts might keep secrets that have been long lost among the living, and you're skilled at talking them into revealing them to you.
records.name: Ghostwhisperer

records.description: You have a soft spot for little, weak animals, and you do everything in your power to protect them - even if you probably eat dragons for breakfast.
records.name: Animal Activist

records.description: You've hugged bears, pushed mammoths and proved your drinking skills. And even though you have a slight hangover, a partially fractured rib and some greasy hair on your tongue, you're quite proud to call yourself a honorary barbarian from now on.
records.name: Honorary Barbarian

records.description: You're the one who poses the questions around here, and you know how to get the answers you want to hear. Besides, you're a famous exorcist and slay a few vampires and demons here and there. You and your stake are a perfect team.
records.name: High Inquisitor

records.description: You're not sure what it is, but you feel drawn to royalty. Your knees are always a bit grazed from crawling around in front of thrones and you love hanging out in castles. Maybe you should consider applying as a guard?
records.name: King Tibianus Fan

records.description: You're a fast runner and are good at delivering wares which are bound to decay just in the nick of time, even if you can't use any means of transportation or if your hands get cold or smelly in the process.
records.name: Just in Time

records.description: You love playing jokes on others and tricking them into looking a little silly. Wagging tongues say that the moment of realisation in your victims' eyes is the reward you feed on, but you're probably just kidding and having fun with them... right??
records.name: Perfect Fool

records.description: Sometimes the biggest secrets of life can have a simple solution.
records.name: Mathemagician

records.description: Delivering letters and parcels has always been a secret passion of yours, and now you can officially put on your blue hat, blow your post horn and do what you like to do most. Beware of dogs!
records.name: Archpostman

records.description: You don't believe in romance to be a coincidence or in love at first sight. In fact - love potions, bouquets of flowers and cheesy poems do the trick much better. Keep those hormones flowing!
records.name: Matchmaker

records.description: Robbing, inviting yourself to VIP parties, faking contracts and pretending to be someone else - you're a jack of all trades when it comes to illegal activities. You take no prisoners, except for the occasional goldfish now and then.
records.name: Master Thief

records.description: You helped bringing Princess Buttercup, Doctor Dumbness and Lucky the Wonder Dog to life - and will probably dream of them tonight, since you memorised your lines perfectly. What a .. special piece of.. screenplay.
records.name: Amateur Actor

records.description: You put out the Spirit of Fire's flames in the arena of Svargrond. Arena fights are for you - fair, square, with simple rules and one-on-one battles.
records.name: Scrapper

records.description: You wiped out Orcus the Cruel in the Arena of Svargrond. You're still a bit green behind the ears, but there's some great potential.
records.name: Greenhorn

records.description: You sent the Obliverator into oblivion in the arena of Svargrond and defeated nine other dangerous enemies on the way. All hail the Warlord of Svargrond!
records.name: Warlord of Svargrond

records.description: You've daringly jumped into the infamous Annihilator and survived - taking home fame, glory and your reward.
records.name: Annihilator

records.description: You were able to fight your way through the countless hordes in the Demon Forge. Once more you proved that nothing is impossible.
records.name: Master of the Nexus

records.description: You're a lord or lady of the dance - and not afraid to use your skills to impress tribal gods. One step to the left, one jump to the right, twist and shout!
records.name: Talented Dancer

records.description: With a perfectly harmless smile you fooled all of those wisecrackers into eating your exploding cookies. Consider a boy or girl scout outfit next time to make the trick even better.
records.name: Allow Cookies?

records.description: You've touched all thrones of the Ruthless Seven and absorbed some of their evil spirit. It may have changed you forever.
records.name: Ruthless

records.description: You won the merciless 2 vs. 2 team tournament on the Isle of Strife and wiped out wave after wave of fearsome opponents. Death or victory - you certainly chose the latter.
records.name: Champion of Chazorai

records.description: Thick, red - shaken, not stirred - and with a straw in it: that's the way you prefer your demon blood. Served with an onion ring, the subtle metallic aftertaste is almost not noticeable. Beneficial effects on health or mana are welcome.
records.name: Demonic Barkeeper

records.description: Six. Six. Six.
records.name: Number of the Beast

records.description: You and your stuffed furry friends are inseparable, and you're not ashamed to take them to bed with you - who knows when you will wake up in the middle of the night in dire need of a cuddle?
records.name: I Need a Hug

records.description: Okay, let's face it - as long as you believe it could potentially lead you to the biggest treasure ever, you won't let go of that map, however fishy it might look. There must be a secret behind all of this!
records.name: Slim Chance

records.description: Up and down and up and down... and then the big looping! Wait - they don't build loopings in Kazordoon. But ore wagon rides are still fun!
records.name: Rollercoaster

records.description: RAWR! Strength running through your body, your heart racing faster and adrenaline fuelling your every weapon swing. All in a little bottle. No refund for destroyed furniture. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
records.name: Berserker

records.description: You feel you could solve the hardest riddles within a minute or so. Plus, there's a nice boost on your spell damage. All in a little bottle. Aftereffects - feeling slightly stupid. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
records.name: Mastermind

records.description: Improved eyesight, arrows and bolts flying at the speed of light and pinning your enemies with extra damage. All in a little bottle. No consumption of carrots required. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
records.name: Sharpshooter

records.description: You have defeated the Snake God's incarnations and, with a final powerful swing of the snake sceptre, cut off his life force supply. The story of power, deceit and corruption has come to an end - or... not?
records.name: Godslayer

records.description: Stealth kills and backstabbing are your specialty. Your numerous victims are usually unaware of their imminent death, which you bring to them silently and swiftly. Everything is permitted.
records.name: Swift Death

records.description: What is best in life? To crush your enemies. To see them driven before you. And to maybe have a nice cup of tea afterwards.
records.name: Brutal Politeness

records.description: You're a beggar, homeless, wearing filthy and ragged clothes. But that doesn't mean you have to beg anyone for stuff - and you still kept your pride. Fine feathers do not necessarily make fine birds - what's under them is more important.
records.name: Life on the Streets

records.description: Wearing the insignia and dark robes of the Brotherhood of Bones you roam the lands spreading fear and pain, creating new soldiers for the necromantic army which is about to rise soon. Hail the Brotherhood.
records.name: Skull and Bones

records.description: You do not fear nightmares, you travel in them - facing countless horrors and fighting the fate they're about to bring. Few believe the dark prophecies you bring back from those dreams, but those who do fight alongside you as Nightmare Knights.
records.name: Nightmare Walker

records.description: Every city should be proud to call someone like you its inhabitant. You're keeping the streets clean and help settling the usual disputes in front of the depot. Also, you probably own a cat and like hiking.
records.name: Exemplary Citizen

records.description: You don't carry that stake just for decoration - you're prepared to use it. Usually you're seen hightailing through the deepest dungeons leaving a trail of slain demons. Whoever dares stand in your way should prepare to die.
records.name: Demonbane

records.description: One with nature, one with wildlife. Raw and animalistic power, sharpened senses, howling on the highest cliffs and roaring in the thickest forests - that's you.
records.name: Of Wolves and Bears

records.description: At daytime you can be found camouflaged in the woods laying traps or chasing big game, at night you're sitting by the campfire and sharing your hunting stories. You eat what you hunted and wear what you skinned. Life could go on like that forever.
records.name: Hunting with Style

records.description: And remember: Never try to teach a pig to sing. It wastes your time and annoys the pig.
records.name: Fool at Heart

records.description: With edged blade and fully equipped in a sturdy full plate armor, you charge at your enemies with both strength and valour. There's always a maiden to save and a dragon to slay for you.
records.name: In Shining Armor

records.description: You begin your day by bathing in your pot of gold and you don't mind showing off your wealth while strolling the streets in your best clothes - after all it's your hard-earned money! You prefer to be addressed with 'Your Highness'.
records.name: Aristocrat

records.description: Snow heaps and hailstorms can't keep you from where you want to go. You're perfectly equipped for any expedition into the perpetual ice and know how to keep your feet warm. If you're a woman, that's quite an accomplishment, too.
records.name: Out in the Snowstorm

records.description: You feel at home under the hot desert sun with sand between your toes, and your favourite means of travel is a flying carpet. Also, you can probably do that head isolation dance move.
records.name: One Thousand and One

records.description: Ye be a gentleman o' fortune, fightin' and carousin' on the high seas, out fer booty and lassies! Ye no be answerin' to no man or blasted monarchy and yer life ain't fer the lily-livered. Aye, matey!
records.name: Swashbuckler

records.description: Shaking your rattle and dancing around the fire to jungle drums sounds like something you like doing. Besides, dreadlocks are a convenient way to wear your hair - no combing required!
records.name: Way of the Shaman

records.description: You could be the author of the magnum opus 'How to Summon the Ultimate Beast from the Infernal Depths, Volume I'. Or, if your mind and heart are pure, you rather summon beings to help others. Or maybe just a little cat to have someone to cuddle.
records.name: Ritualist

records.description: You're not afraid to show your colours in the heat of battle. Enemies fear your lethal lance and impenetrable armor. The list of the wars you've won is impressive. Hail and kill!
records.name: Master of War

records.description: Valour is for weaklings - it doesn't matter how you win the battle, as long as you're victorious. Thick armor would just hinder your movements, thus you keep it light and rely on speed and skill instead of hiding in an uncomfortable shell.
records.name: Wild Warrior

records.description: You're a humble warrior who doesn't need wealth or specialised equipment for travelling and fighting. You feel at home in the northern lands of Zao and did your part in fighting its corruption.
records.name: Peazzekeeper

records.description: Your deeds for Yalahar are usually characterised by deep insight and thoughtful actions. Thanks to you, Yalahar might have a chance to grow peacefully and with happy people living in it.
records.name: Yalahari of Wisdom

records.description: You defend Yalahar with brute force and are ready to lead it into a glorious battle, if necessary. Thanks to you, Yalahar will be powerful enough to stand up against any enemy.
records.name: Yalahari of Power

records.description: Life can be so easy with the right cake at the right time - and you mastered baking many different ones, so you should be prepared for almost everything life decides to throw at you.
records.name: Piece of Cake

records.description: You're considered a first-rate graduate of the Magic Academy in Edron due to your pioneering discoveries and successful studies in the field of experimental magic and spell development. Ever considered teaching the Armageddon spell?
records.name: Alumni

records.description: You're proficient in the darker ways of magic and are usually found sitting inside a circle of candles and skulls muttering unspeakable words. Don't carry things too far or the demons might come get you.
records.name: Warlock

records.description: True scientists know their equipment. Testing new inventions is essential daily work for any hard working researcher. You showed no fear and took all the new equipment from Spectulus and Sinclair for a spin.
records.name: Guinea Pig

records.description: You went into the forest, met Rottin Wood and the Married Men and helped them out in their camp. Oh, and don't worry about those merchants. They won't dare mentioning the strangely large sums of gold they actually possessed which are missing now.
records.name: Merry Adventures

records.description: You passed their test and helped the Spirithunters testing equipment, researching the supernatural and catching ghosts - it's you they're gonna call.
records.name: Afraid of no Ghost!

records.description: You've discovered the Ancients' hidden powers - from now on, they will aid you in your adventures.
records.name: Hidden Powers

records.description: You significantly helped the afflicted citizens of Venore in times of dire need. Somehow you still feel close to the victims of the fever outbreak. Your clothes make you one of them, one poor soul amongst the countless afflicted.
records.name: Beak Doctor

records.description: You vanquished the mad mage, you subdued the raging mage - no spellweaving self-exposer can stand in your way. Yet you are quite absorbed in magical studies yourself. This very fabric reflects this personal approval of the magic arts.
records.name: Mystic Fabric Magic

records.description: You've shattered each of Bloodweb's eight frozen legs. As they say: break a leg, and then some more.
records.name: Arachnoise

records.description: You've descended into the swampy depths of Deathbine's lair and made quick work of it.
records.name: Rootless Behaviour

records.description: You've slain Esmeralda, the most hideous and aggressive of the mutated rats. No one will know that you almost lost a finger in the process.
records.name: Twisted Mutation

records.description: Ethershreck's cry of agony kept ringing in your ear for hours after he had dissolved into thin air. He probably moved to another plane of existence... for a while.
records.name: Beautiful Agony

records.description: A mighty blaze went out today. It's Flameborn's turn to wait for his rebirth in the eternal cycle of life and death.
records.name: Scorched Flames

records.description: You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
records.name: Crawling Death

records.description: You made a knot with Gorgo's living curls and took her scalp. You couldn't save her countless petrified victims, but at least you didn't become one.
records.name: The Serpent's Bride

records.description: You've found a well-hidden spider queen and caught her off guard in the middle of her meal.
records.name: No More Hiding

records.description: It seems the gates to the underworld have to remain unprotected for a while. Kerberos, the mighty hellhound, lost his head. All three of them.
records.name: The Gates of Hell

records.description: As the killer of Leviathan, the giant sea serpent, his underwater kingdom is now under your reign.
records.name: The Drowned Sea God

records.description: Ribstride is striding no more. He had quite a few ribs to spare though.
records.name: Spareribs for Dinner

records.description: You almost made friends with Shardhead... before he died. Poor guy only seems to attract violence with his frosty attitude.
records.name: Breaking the Ice

records.description: Stonecracker's head was much softer than the stones he threw at you.
records.name: Just Cracked Me Up!

records.description: You've extinguished the Sulphur Scuttler's gas clouds and made the air in his cave a little better... at least for a while.
records.name: Something Smells

records.description: You've impaled the big mammoth Bloodtusk with his own tusks.
records.name: Meat Skewer

records.description: The Many is no more, but how many more are there? One can never know.
records.name: One Less

records.description: You've vanquished the Noxious Spawn and his serpentine heart.
records.name: Hissing Downfall

records.description: The Old Widow fell prey to your supreme hunting skills.
records.name: Choking on Her Venom

records.description: You've tainted the jungle floor with the Snapper's crimson blood.
records.name: Blood-Red Snapper

records.description: You've cut off a whole lot of tentacles today. Thul was driven back to where he belongs.
records.name: Back into the Abyss

records.description: You've stopped the bank robber and returned the bag full of gold. Good to know there are still lawful Tibians like you around.
records.name: Honest Finder

records.description: You managed to catch a fish in a surrounding that usually doesn't even carry water. Everything is subject to change, probably...
records.name: Desert Fisher

records.description: You showed Noodles the way home. How long will it take this time until he's on the loose again? That dog must be really bored in the throne room by now.
records.name: Dog Sitter

records.description: You witnessed the thawing of Svargrond and harvested rare seeds from some strange icy plants. They must be good for something.
records.name: Ice Harvester

records.description: You've discovered three nomad camps and stole their supplies. Well, you can probably use them better than they can.
records.name: Chest Robber

records.description: You've found a secret dungeon in the flooded plains and killed several of its inhabitants. And now you have wet feet.
records.name: Down the Drain

records.description: You've survived the Hellgorge eruption and found a way through the flames and lava. You've even managed to kill a few fireborn on the way.
records.name: Fire from the Earth

records.description: Your actions start to make a difference. You have blinded the antennae of the hive often enough to become an annoyance to it.
records.name: Minor Disturbance

records.description: In the war against the hive, your efforts in blinding it begin to pay off. Your actions have blinded the hive severely and the entity seems to become aware that something dangerous is happening.
records.name: Dazzler

records.description: You have put a lot of time and energy into keeping the hive unaware of what is happening on Quirefang. The hive learnt to fear your actions. It would surely crush you with all its might ... if it could only find you!
records.name: Hive Blinder

records.description: You have grown accustomed to frequenting the hive's stomach system. Your actions have caused the hive some first digestion problems.
records.name: Hickup

records.description: Never-tiring, you attack the inner organs of the mighty hive. Your attacks on the hive's digestion system begin to cause some trouble.
records.name: Heartburn

records.description: You severely disrupted the digestion of the hive. The hive should for sure see a doctor. It seems you proved to be more than it can swallow.
records.name: Stomach Ulcer

records.description: The hive has to be fought with might and main, hampering its soldiers is only the first step. You diligently stopped the pores of the hive to spread its warriors.
records.name: Planter

records.description: You are getting more and more experienced in destroying the supply of the enemy's forces. Your actions caused the hive some severe skin problems.
records.name: Pimple

records.description: A war is won by those who have the best supply of troops. The hive's troops have been dealt a significant blow by your actions. You interrupted the hive's replenishment of troops lastingly and severely.
records.name: Suppressor

records.description: By killing creatures of the hive and gaining weapons for further missions, you started a quite effective way of war. You gathered a lot of dissolved chitin to resupply the war effort.
records.name: Gatherer

records.description: The need for supplies often decides over loss or victory. Your tireless efforts to resupply the resources keeps the war against the hive going.
records.name: Supplier

records.description: You have become competent and efficient in gathering the substance that is needed to fight the hive. You almost smell like dissolved chitin and the Hive Born would tell their children scary stories about you if they could speak.
records.name: Chitin Bane

records.description: You have proven that you can beat the best of the hive. You have caused first promising breaches in the defence of the hive.
records.name: Guard Killer

records.description: The most powerful warriors of the hive were killed by you by the dozens. The hive is not safe anymore because of your actions.
records.name: Hive Infiltrator

records.description: Efficient and lethal, you have gained significant experience in fighting the elite forces of the hive. Almost single-handed, you have slain the best of the Hive Born and live to tell the tale.
records.name: Exterminator

records.description: Even in the deepest structures of the hive, you began to strike against the mighty foe. Your actions probably already gave the hive a headache.
records.name: Headache

records.description: The destruction you have caused by now can be felt throughout the whole hive. The mayhem that follows your step caused significant confusion in the consciousness of the hive.
records.name: Confusion

records.description: You have destroyed a significant amount of the hive's vital nerve centres and caused massive destruction to the hive's awareness. You are probably causing the hive horrible nightmares.
records.name: Manic

records.description: You've found the oriental traveller Yasir and were able to trade with him - even if you didn't really understand his language.
records.name: Si, Ariki!

records.description: You ended the life of over three hundred Deepling Guards. Not quite the guardian of the Deeplings, are you?
records.name: Guardian Downfall

records.description: You hushed the songs of war in the black depths by silencing more than three hundred Deepling Spellsingers.
records.name: Death Song

records.description: By eliminating at least three hundred Deepling Warriors you delivered quite a blow to the amassing armies of the deep.
records.name: Depth Dwellers

records.description: You travelled the depths of this very world. You entered the blackness of the deep sea to conquer the realm of the Deeplings. May this suit remind you of the strange beauty below.
records.name: Spolium Profundis

records.description: Countless fights and never tiring effort in the war against the hive grant you the experience to finish your outfit with the last remaining part. Your chitin outfit is a testament of your skills and dedication for the cause.
records.name: Bane of the Hive

records.description: Your invaluable experience in fighting the hive allows you to add another piece of armor to your chitin outfit to prove your dedication for the cause.
records.name: Hive War Veteran

records.description: You have participated that much in the hive war, that you are able to create some makeshift armor from the remains of dead hive born that can be found in the major hive, to show off your skill.
records.name: Hive Fighter

records.description: You muted the everlasting howling of Hemming.
records.name: Howly Silence

records.description: No more fear and bad dreams. You stabbed Tormentor to death with its scythe leg.
records.name: Dream's Over

records.description: You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain.
records.name: Zzztill Zzztanding!

records.description: This time you knocked out the big one.
records.name: Stepped on a Big Toe

records.description: No joke, you murdered the bat.
records.name: Kapow!

records.description: You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
records.name: Enter zze Draken!

records.description: Bretzecutioner's body just got slammed away. You are a true king of the ring!
records.name: King of the Ring

records.description: You overcame the undead Zanakeph and sent him back into the darkness that spawned him.
records.name: Back from the Dead

records.description: You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
records.name: Nestling

records.description: You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
records.name: Becoming a Bigfoot

records.description: You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
records.name: Gnome Little Helper

records.description: The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
records.name: Gnome Friend

records.description: You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
records.name: Gnomelike

records.description: You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
records.name: Honorary Gnome

records.description: You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. To bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
records.name: Crystals in Love

records.description: Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
records.name: Substitute Tinker

records.description: After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
records.name: Spore Hunter

records.description: Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
records.name: Grinding Again

records.description: So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
records.name: Crystal Keeper

records.description: Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
records.name: Call Me Sparky

records.description: One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gnomes are wrong and size matters?
records.name: One Foot Vs. Many

records.description: The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable? <sigh>
records.name: The Picky Pig

records.description: Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
records.name: Funghitastic

records.description: If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you probably would have changed your underwear in time.
records.name: Crystal Clear

records.description: You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
records.name: Gnomish Art of War

records.description: Assisting Omrabas' sick plan to resurrect made you dig your way through the blood-soaked halls of Drefia. Maybe better he failed!
records.name: Gravedigger

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Swordsman

records.description: You helped the gnomes of the Spike in securing the caves and explored enough of the lightless depths to earn you a complete cave explorer's outfit. Well done!
records.name: Cave Completionist

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Bladelord

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Headsman

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Executioner

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Brawler

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Berserker

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Archer

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Marksman

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Harbinger

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
records.name: Umbral Master

records.description: What a scientific discovery - they really DO communicate! Using their own communication habits against them, you lured a large pack of silencers away from the walls of Roshamuul.
records.name: Luring Silence

records.description: You did not show any signs of surrender to any sight of... you get the picture. Even a hundred of them did not pose a threat to you.
records.name: Never Surrender

records.description: You have mended many a broken dream and so, the dream of Roshamuul is safely being told over and over again.
records.name: Dream Wright

records.description: You have cleansed the lands of many retching horrors. You sure know how to end a bad dream: forcefully, that's how!
records.name: Ending the Horror

records.description: You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
records.name: Sleepwalking

records.description: It doesn't matter what noise you would hear... dream, nightmare, illusion - there is nothing you can't vanquish. You are a true Dream Warden.
records.name: Dream Warden

records.description: Gaz'haragoth... a day to remember! Your world accomplished something really big - and you have been part of it!
records.name: Prison Break

records.description: After a battle like this you know who your friends are.
records.name: Noblesse Obliterated

records.description: Through the spirit of science and exploration, you have discovered how to enter the secret hideout of the renowned Dr Merlay.
records.name: Elementary, My Dear

records.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of a Commoner.
records.name: Rathleton Commoner

records.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of a Inhabitant.
records.name: Rathleton Inhabitant

records.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of a Citizen.
records.name: Rathleton Citizen

records.description: Though you may have averted a dire threat for Rathleton, this relative peace may only hold for a while. At least you've scavenged an outfit from some of the poor fellows that have fallen prey to death priest Shargon.
records.name: Glooth Engineer

records.description: Adventure is your middle name. You spent much time in dangerous lands and have seen things others only dream of. You know your way around in Tibia - you are a seasoned adventurer now. And your journey has only just begun!
records.name: Seasoned Adventurer

records.description: You've got a mind ready to draw strange conclusions that defy the laws of logic and sidestep reality. Or maybe it's just a lucky guess - or adventurous recklessness?
records.name: Mind the Step!

records.description: By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of a Squire.
records.name: Rathleton Squire

records.description: He seriously stored away a wallnut? That was a nutty professor indeed.
records.name: The Professor's Nut

records.description: You are a man of the public. Or of good publicity at least. Through your efforts in advertising the airtight cloth, Zeronex might yet be redeemed - and Rathleton might yet see its first working Gloud Ship.
records.name: Publicity

records.description: By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
records.name: Snake Charmer

records.description: You found a lost sheep and thus a steady source of black wool. But careful: don't get entangled.
records.name: Little Ball of Wool

records.description: You made some efforts to bring a little more light into the world. And what a nice present you got in return!
records.name: Luminous Kitty

records.description: By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
records.name: The Right Tone

records.description: Having a loyal friend alongside is comforting to every adventurer. If only this lad was not so stubborn ...
records.name: Loyal Lad

records.description: It's not really a dragon, but rather a kind of chimera. Nonetheless a decent mount to impress any passer-by.
records.name: Dragon Mimicry

records.description: The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
records.name: Scales and Tail

records.description: There are many delusions and phantasms in the desert. You saw a false oasis with fruit-bearing palm trees. Instead of water and refreshment, however, you found a dromedary in the end. What a useful Fata Morgana!
records.name: Fata Morgana

records.description: Finding all the pieces to this complicated vehicle was one kind of a challenge. However, what you built in the end is rather a fabled than a feeble construction.
records.name: Fabled Construction

records.description: Barking dogs never bite, as the saying goes. But this one clearly tried. In the end, however, you were able to walk the dog - ahem, gnarlhound.
records.name: Mind the Dog!

records.description: This magnetic beast attracted you in a very literal way. Or was it attracted by your metal equipment? Anyway, you seem to be stuck together now.
records.name: Magnetised

records.description: Counting ten thousand grains of sand could not have been harder than gaining this impressive mount.
records.name: Golden Sands

records.description: Kingly deers mostly prefer elves as friends and familiars. This one, however, decided to favour you as a confidant and rider. Well done!
records.name: Friend of Elves

records.description: Finding a four-leaved clover is always a sign of luck. And as luck would have it, you even baited a lovely dotted ladybug. Lucky you!
records.name: Lovely Dots

records.description: This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
records.name: Way to Hell

records.description: Not really twenty thousand miles, but you had to dive a fair way beneath the sea to find your personal Manta Ray.
records.name: Beneath the Sea

records.description: By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
records.name: Starless Night

records.description: By mastering the secrets of Lions Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
records.name: Lion King

records.description: Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
records.name: Pecking Order

records.description: Whoa, sow long! This boar is like a force of nature, breaking through the undergrowth of all the Tibian forests and all records of speed. Hang on!
records.name: Pig-Headed

records.description: It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
records.name: Personal Nightmare

records.description: It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
records.name: Thick-Skinned

records.description: Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
records.name: Chequered Teddy

records.description: Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
records.name: Blacknailed

records.description: Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug.  Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
records.name: Slugging Around

records.description: It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
records.name: Knock on Wood

records.description: This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
records.name: Fried Shrimp

records.description: What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
records.name: Out of the Stone Age

records.description: A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
records.name: Stuntman

records.description: Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
records.name: Gear Up

records.description: Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
records.name: Bearbaiting

records.description: 'Sweets for my steed' could be your motto. An impressive horse is eating out of your hand. Saddle up and be ready to find adventure, new friends, and maybe someone to shoe your horse now and then.
records.name: Lucky Horseshoe

records.description: By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
records.name: Swamp Beast

records.description: Seems like this spider has got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
records.name: Spin-Off

records.description: Here's looking at you, kid. This ancient creature seems to size you up with its brilliant eyes and barely tolerates you riding it. Maybe it thinks you're the defrosted snack, after all?
records.name: Icy Glare

records.description: You succeeded in finding and charting several previously unexplored landmarks and locations for the Adventurer's Guild, you probably never need to ask anyone for the way - do you?
records.name: Cartography 101

records.description: You went through hell. Seven times. You defeated the demons. Countless times. You put an end to Ferumbras' claims to ascendancy. Once and for all.
records.name: Rift Warrior

records.description: You sucessfully fought against all odds to protect your world from an ascending god! - You weren't there for the hat only after all?
records.name: Hat Hunter

records.description: You didn't manage to become an ogre chief. But at least you are, beyond doubt, a worthy ogre chef.
records.name: Ogre Chef

records.description: You opposed man-eating ogres and clumys clomps. You grappled with hungry chieftains, desperate goblins and angry spirits. So you truly overcame the wild vastness of Krailos.
records.name: The Call of the Wild

records.description: You have entered the heart of destruction and valiantly defeated the world devourer. By your actions you have postponed the end of the world - at least for a while.
records.name: Ender of the End

records.description: After a long journey and dedication you were favoured by fortune and have tamed all three elusive beasts of the vortex. Unless the Vortexion decides you're a tasty morsel you can enjoy your small stable of ravaging beasts from beyond.
records.name: Vortex Tamer

records.description: Don't forget, even your rhino sometimes needs a hug. A careful one in this case.
records.name: Rhino Rider

records.description: You met the legendary First Dragon and survived. That's a reason to celebrate for sure.
records.name: Reason to Celebrate

records.description: You assisted a very prominent fae and you fought tooth and nail to earn this title.
records.name: Toothfairy Assistant

records.description: You have managed to stall the worst incursion of corruption. Still this is just one battle won in an all out war for your world.
records.name: Corruption Contained

records.description: You have fully unlocked 10 easy monsters in the cyclopedia.
records.name: Little Adventure

records.description: You have fully unlocked 10 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
records.name: Contender

records.description: You have fully unlocked 10 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
records.name: Skilled Hunter

records.description: You have fully unlocked your very first monster in the cyclopedia.
records.name: Hunting Permit

records.description: The Curse of the Full Moon transforms harmless citizens into feral beasts. But with your help, Edron and Cormaya are safe - fairly.
records.name: Over the Moon

records.description: You defeated the Count of the Core and destroyed his lava pump!
records.name: His Days are Counted

records.description: You defeated the Duke of the Depths and destroyed his lava pump!
records.name: Duked It Out

records.description: You defeated the Baron from Below and destroyed his lava pump!
records.name: Buried the Baron

records.description: The Baron from Below, Duke of the Depths and the Count of the Core are no more!
records.name: Death in the Depths

records.description: You took the heat and defeated the Ancient Spawn of Morgathla!
records.name: Scourge of Scarabs

records.description: Exploring the depths of Tibia can be a dangerous task. Surprisingly, some crude wood planks, rusty nails and a tinged pot can offer a sufficient protection against the creatures lurking in the deep.
records.name: Cobbled and Patched

records.description: Putting this candle stump on your new mount was kind of a waiting game. You're even tempted to call it whack-a-mole. But in the end you found a loyal companion for your journeys into the depths.
records.name: Up the Molehill

records.description: Tall trees, deep forests and and the beauty of Ab'Dendriel - you really know every corner of the elven lands now.
records.name: Elven Woods

records.description: Ancient battlefields, amazons and the glory of Carlin - you really know every corner of Queen Eloise's realm now.
records.name: Long Live the Queen

records.description: Strong fortresses, sprawling woods and ivory towers - you really know every corner of Edron now.
records.name: Stronghold of Edron

records.description: Vast mines, an orc fortress and the magnificence of Kazordoon - you really know every corner of North-Eastern Mainland now.
records.name: Dwarven Mines

records.description: Old temples, a meadowy countryside and the splendour of Thais - you really know every corner of King Tibianus' realm now.
records.name: All Hail the King

records.description: Damp swamps, a dry desert and the opulence of Venore - you really know every corner of Eastern Mainland now.
records.name: Jewel in the Swamp

records.description: A vast steppe, voracious ogres and dried out salt seas - you really know every corner of Krailos now.
records.name: The Ogre Steppe

records.description: Lush meadows, colourful fairies and sentient stones - you really know every corner of Feyrist now.
records.name: Realms of Dreams

records.description: You have combed the desert and searched the pyramid city of Ankrahmun.
records.name: Mummy's Dearest

records.description: You journeyed through Darashia and the sea of sand around it, while fighting the perils of the desert.
records.name: Daraman's Footsteps

records.description: You have searched Port Hope and the jungle that thoroughly, that you are up to adoption by a friendly ape family.
records.name: King of the Jungle

records.description: You've braved the perils of Yalahar and learned of its gloomy shadows of long gone greatness.
records.name: Ancient Splendor

records.description: A pirate's haven and a burglar's hideout. You found your way around Liberty Bay and its surroundings - land, ho!
records.name: Liberty Bay Watch

records.description: You have expelled the fog of the unknown from the islands of Svargrond. Maybe not as first, but that's not what matters in the end.
records.name: Race to the Pole

records.description: From the southern steppe through the Dragonblaze Mountains and the Muggy Plains to the forbidden city of Razachai - you really know every corner of Zao now.
records.name: Lizard Kingdom

records.description: Braving a hive full of unimaginable proportions and its grotesque creatures on the surface is only one side of Gray Beach. Your full trip of the island also included a dive into the black nothingness of the deep sea, facing the wrath of the Njey.
records.name: Trip to the Beach

records.description: Glooth is the substance that powers a whole continent and all its weird inhabitants, workshops and factories. You travelled this strange smorgasbord of curiosities in its entirety - just in time for tea.
records.name: Glooth Punk

records.description: A journey through a dreamscape of evil is no small feat. Yet you traversed the nightmarish lands of Roshamuul and live to tell the tale. Don't fall asleep now...
records.name: Twisted Dreams

records.description: Though you couldn't prevent the theft of the godbreaker knowledge, you still managed to fight off the invasion of the library and to kill the scourge of oblivion, a powerful servant of the enemy.
records.name: Library Liberator

records.description: You passion for reading was somewhat diminished by biting books and aggressive quills. But this flying specimen proved to be a loyal companion. Never judge a book by its cover!
records.name: Bibliomaniac

records.description: Wielding dangerous knowledge as well as the sword is your expertise. You have proven yourself versatile in all manner of situations.
records.name: Battle Mage

records.description: As a true globetrotter you can now show your colours proudly with this extraordinary outfit.
records.name: Widely Travelled

records.description: You don't just have a permission to ride a rift runner, you literally went through hell and earned it!
records.name: Running the Rift

records.description: Not only did you master the battlefield as a mage, you were also induced to the most inner secrets of the art of magical warfare and prevailed.
records.name: Exalted Battle Mage

records.description: You found the Seven Keys to unlock ... no, not the seven seas. But at least seven doors in the realm of dreams.
records.name: Keeper of the 7 Keys

records.description: You became an acquaintance of the courts of dreams and acquired the right to display your new status and title of 'dream warrior'.
records.name: Dream Warrior

records.description: Your lantern was too bewitching for a hibernal moth. It couldn't withstand and follows you, the bearer of the lantern, now.
records.name: Moth Whisperer

records.description: You caught a lacewing moth with your lantern. It will follow you in companionship as the bearer of the lantern will be its guide through the darkness now.
records.name: Lacewing Catcher

records.description: This sleigh is not driven by magic but pushed by a percht. Hopefully you two get along well together...!
records.name: No Horse Open Sleigh

records.description: But can you truly be one of them?
records.name: Raider in the Dark

records.description: You are the slayer of the ancient nightmare beast and prevented the nightmare to spread its madness.
records.name: Dream Catcher

records.description: Unmasking spies, killing demons, discovering omens, solving puzzles and fighting ogres, manticores and feral sphinxes. - Nobody said it was easy to become a gryphon rider.
records.name: Gryphon Rider

records.description: You made sure that the balance of sun and sea is preserved in Kilmaresh. The Golden City of Issavi won't forget your favour.
records.name: Sun and Sea

records.description: You defeated the Lich Knights and became the hand of the Inquisition, allowed to wear their special garb.
records.name: Inquisition's Hand

records.description: Mythical creatures, forgotten catacombs and the Golden City - you really know every corner of Kilmaresh now.
records.name: The Empire's Glory

records.description: Your special garb, solely awarded to a dedicated hand of the Inquisition, is now complete.
records.name: Inquisition's Arm

records.description: You proudly wear the traditional Orcsoberfest garb, same as it ever was and as it always will be.
records.name: Traditionalist

records.description: Riding a traditional Orcsoberfest beer barrel is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Beer sold separately.
records.name: Do a Barrel Roll!

records.description: You have tamed the ghostly mists to do your bidding. For now ...
records.name: Nothing but Hot Air

records.description: And so it begins!
records.name: Verminbane

records.description: Fear me, monsters! There is some more slaying to come!
records.name: Monsterhunter

records.description: Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!
records.name: Taskmaster

records.description: Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment.
records.name: Mainstreet Nightmare

records.description: A true beastmaster learns the language of his animal companions. Now you as well can bolster your unique bond with nature and help preserve the balance of life as a proud falconer.
records.name: Falconer

records.description: Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.
records.name: Steppe Elegance

records.description: Adventurous beyond death, you travelled the Netherworld. Although you had just the ghost of a chance you survived and even came back from the realm of the dead.
records.name: Beyonder

records.description: If a pride of lions and a pack of hyaenas feud, it is not called a catfight but a ... whatsoever. For sure, it caused a lot of drama in the Darama Desert.
records.name: Drama in Darama

records.description: You bested the maleficent duo Drume and Fugue and restored order to the besieged town of Bounac. You conquered the exotic stronghold of the Order of the Cobra and bested the undead knights of the Order of the Falcon. A true knight in heart and mind.
records.name: Lionheart

records.description: Brought back to the realm of the living this magnificent creature will carry you through death and everything that lays beyond.
records.name: You Got Horse Power

records.description: You defeated the manifestation of Goshnar's evil traits by fighting your way through beasts you didn't even want to imagine. It transformed you and now you can also look the part.
records.name: Unleash the Beast

records.description: You helped Domizian and thus proved yourself worthy to enter the werelion sanctum underneath Lion's Rock.You faced the mighty werelions there and one of the rare white lions even chose to accompany you.
records.name: Well Roared, Lion!

records.description: When in Rascacoon, do as the Rascoohans do!
records.name: Honorary Rascoohan

records.description: Riding around on this squishy companion gives you the feeling of flying through the air... uhm... swimming through the seven seas!
records.name: Release the Kraken

records.description: Your thirst for knowledge is insatiable. In the task of helping your gnomish friends, flawless execution is just the icing on the cake.
records.name: Knowledge Raider

records.description: It was not the first time that you helped the Sapphire Blade or the Midnight Flame with a difficult task. You may now wear the Kilmareshian robes as well as the tagralt blade and the eye-embroidered veil of the seers as a sign of Issavi's gratitude.
records.name: Citizen of Issavi

records.description: Your continued efforts in keeping Bounac and the people of Kesar the Younger safe, earned you a permanent place at the royal court as an advisor to the king.
records.name: King's Council

records.description: Since it is fireproof, this flaming creature feels right at home in raging infernos. But remember: just because it doesn't burn, you still do!
records.name: Hot on the Trail

records.description: Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
records.name: Shell We Take a Ride

records.description: This mighty pachyderm will march into battle as if just taking its Sunday stroll. The cost of friendship was only a few drome points!
records.name: Phantastic!

records.description: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
records.name: Some Like It Hot

records.description: Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
records.name: Sharp Dressed

records.description: This glooth-driven locomotive will bring you to any party in the blink of an eye.
records.name: Engine Driver

records.description: You mastered the fire and tamed a supervulcano!
records.name: Friendly Fire

records.description: Alas! What could be more beautiful and satisfying than bringing two loving hearts together? So romantic!
records.name: Wedding Planner

records.description: You really were as busy as a beaver in order to help the nagas. Enjoy some eager company!
records.name: Beaver Away

records.description: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
records.name: Snake Pit

records.description: For some it can't be hazardous enough.
records.name: Royalty of Hazard

records.description: Step by step you discovered many of the secrets hidden in the world, thus gaining the right to wear the Discoverer outfit and hat. Made-to-measure for a brave traveller of the Tibian wilds.
records.name: Measuring the World

records.description: Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your ripptor.
records.name: Ripp-Ripp Hooray!

records.description: Combining unabating courage in combat and respect for the traditions and culture of the ancient Iks earned you the honours of true Aucar.
records.name: Warrior of the Iks

records.description: You accomplished the impossible and created 16 mutagens of corresponding colours.
records.name: Mutagenius

records.description: Only its rider can love this abomination of a mount.
records.name: Strangest Thing

records.description: You defeated the embodiments of decay and live to tell the tale, wear the rotting attire of the unfaltering defender proudly.
records.name: Fully Decayed

records.description: Sly as a fox, quiet as a mouse - the perfect mount for a stealthy foray.
records.name: Like Fox and Mouse

records.description: Withstanding both filth and desolation of the rotten darkness that corrupted the very core of this world, you embodied the weapon of purity and light to defy all that was tainted. This spirit will continue guide you on all future paths.
records.name: The Spirit of Purity

records.description: You unveiled the secret plot of the Mitmah who stole away an entire civilisation for their own entertainment. Let the death of their outpost vanguard be an eternal lesson to them.
records.name: Museum Goer

records.description: Proving your true worth to a mystic creature like the jaguar, king of the hunt, granted you not only respect but also its heart.
records.name: Mystic Predator

records.description: You almost feel as cool as a raccoon. Now, where's the trash?
records.name: The Rule of Raccool

records.description: ... on a pegasus, to a land of honey and milk. With this beautiful flying steed you certainly can.
records.name: I Wanna Fly Away

records.description: Traversing the innards of Podzilla was a conquest in and by itself, thanks to Two Lips you are now one with the plant biosphere as you stride its many intertwined trails.
records.name: The Rootwalker

records.description: The Soulpit resonates as the spirit of your final foe shatters under your might.
records.name: Soul Crusher

records.description: The transcendence to a higher state of mind and existence in order to achieve inner peace has been amplified by various means throghout Medudri history. Among them a manifold of potions with varying potence - it seems some of them actually work...
records.name: Inner Peace

records.description: Riding such an ancient beast is certainly a good and harmless idea.
records.name: Fiend Rider

records.description: No living fiends were hurt to achieve this outfit.
records.name: Fiend Slayer

records.description: On the shoulders of demons, you tore through veils of venomous corruption. Demonic essences made you an unstoppable force but take care to also foster your human side.
records.name: Tear the Toxic Veil

records.description: You followed the Three-Fold Path as did generations of Merudri before you. Carry the legacy, culture and hope of the Merudri proudly into this realm, the hearts of its people and beyond.
records.name: Hope of the Merudri

records.description: You managed to create, improve and transform your katar into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
records.name: Umbral Redeemer

records.description: Pray it never finds its way back to its original stable with you still riding.
records.name: Hell Rider

records.description: You never can tell, who's boss here.
records.name: Alpha Rider

records.description: The first step to greatness has been done.
records.name: The First of Many

records.description: Your expertise in weaponry reaches new heights.
records.name: A Well-Honed Arsenal

records.description: Feared by your enemies, admired by many - your reputation in weapon mastery precedes you.
records.name: Arsenal of War

records.description: No matter your command, this beast is all ears!
records.name: Bat Person

records.description: Joran and Yvette have brought the colours back to the world, and you have freed it from the monsters of this story. The world of books is now yours.
records.name: Illuminator

records.description: The pen is mightier than the sword. In a way, yes, you have had this experience. You have seen with your own eyes what the power of words can do, the written word, to be precise.
records.name: Power of Words

records.description: Your stash is cleared, your bestiary completed but the grind has only just begun.
records.name: Errand Runner

records.description: Whether it's clearing cellars from rats or delivering quara eyes with a smile, you get the job done.
records.name: Workhorse

records.description: You don't just read the bulletin board, you live on it.
records.name: Taskaholic

records.description: From rotworms in caves to dragons in the sky, no creature is safe from your overzealous swatting.
records.name: Pest Control

records.description: You freed the remnants of the Order of the Stag on the Isle of Ada from a warlock's yoke. An evil puppet master who lead many Stags against their own brethren. Eldoran the Ambitious, heir of Eldoran Etzel, Cadwgan's bastard son, is forever grateful.
records.name: Bastard

records.description: You've learned the way of the wilderness: its patience, its fury, its grace. As a feral trapper, you embody them all.
records.name: Feral Trapper

records.description: You have spent 70.000.000 gold overall to fund the Great Expedition. Congratulations for helping to make this dream come true!
records.name: Stakeholder

records.description: You have your principles and that is also reflected in your vote for the crew of the Great Expedition.
records.name: Principled

records.description: The hungry ram devoured the whole bunch of turnips in a single bite, then looked at you as if it was ready for more. Make sure to keep it well fed along the way.
records.name: A reliable Friend

records.description: You are quite curious about these echoes.
records.name: Echo Initiate

records.description: The echoes are beginning to infiltrate your dreams.
records.name: Echo Hunter

records.description: Walking past an echo is no option. You're already addicted.
records.name: Echo Walker

records.description: Swift and silent, the jaracal now runs at your side.
records.name: Six Steps Ahead

records.description: On top of a cloud, the sun is always shining.
records.name: Radiant Nimbus

records.description: You answered the call of the moon goddess and thwarted the asuri's plans. Yet the echoes will linger, and the whisper of the moonsilver is now a part of Marapur.
records.name: Amati's Echo

records.description: You stared into the Light without blinking. Foolish or enlightened... who can tell?
records.name: Enlightened, Indeed

records.description: Being the captain is as much a privilege to some as it is a burden to others. You took the helm by doing everything to make the Great Expedition succeed. Steer clear of trouble, stay your course and a bright future will always be ahead of you!
records.name: Aye-aye, Captain!

records.description: As an avid collector you managed to complete a full set of rubber ducks during the Great Expedition and traded it for a unique noble bath tub! Given you will acquire even more ducks in the future, this is the proper way to launch them!
records.name: Rubber Ducking

records.description: Your outstanding work towards the launch of the Great Expedition turned out well for you. You decided it's time to take a break and the Landsailer for a spin! May you always have wind in your sails and a hand-width of even ground under your wheels!
records.name: Sail Away!
